Um, in order to change your life, you need to make big returns. In order to make big returns, you got to do some of the work. That's what we're going to talk about today. In our deals, we make huge margins on deals just like this. I drove by this house literally to film this video and realize it is van vacant, abandoned, and these folks are $25,000 behind on taxes. In our world, that's a perfect deal. But if you're not trained, you don't know how to spot it. Everybody else drives by here and doesn't see money. I drive by this and see wealth, new cars, family, finances, and everything else that I need right here on this dumpy site. This is my brand of real estate. Distressed property acquisition and curative title and how curative title supports distress property acquisition. They go hand in hand. You can't have one without the other. And along the way, I built this incredible business that does tens of millions of dollars a year. I'll never forget when I started these deals in the oil field. I had no clue that any of this stuff would work. The way it would work at that time is I would try to find messes and start to solve them and invest money and time and most of them really worked out and I was able to cautiously earn.
